label: 模型与任务
def: 按模态和任务组织的模型与算法及其开源实现：大语言与多模态模型、结构化决策模型、视觉、语音、图像与视频生成、经典 NLP、强化学习、推荐系统

subs.label: 大语言与多模态模型
subs.def: 开源权重的基座 / 推理 / 代码 / 多模态大语言模型，含 GPT-2、Llama 这类早期模型
subs.def_en: Open-weight base, reasoning, coding, and multimodal language models, including early ones such as GPT-2 and Llama

subs.label: 结构化决策模型
subs.def: 根据输入上下文，对调用方指定的选项、等级或是非问题直接输出类型化判断与概率的模型；不生成开放式文本
subs.def_en: Models that directly return typed choices, scores, or yes/no probabilities for caller-defined questions over input context, rather than generating open-ended text

subs.label: 预训练模型与经典 NLP
subs.def: 非通用聊天大模型的预训练基础模型（如 BERT、时序与金融模型），以及传统 NLP 库和序列建模工具；通用生成式语言模型归「大语言与多模态模型」
subs.def_en: Pretrained models other than general-purpose chat LLMs (such as BERT, time-series, and financial models), plus traditional NLP libraries and sequence-modeling tools; general generative language models belong in LLMs & Multimodal Models

subs.label: 计算机视觉
subs.def: 目标检测、分割、人脸与姿态、视觉基础模型与 3D 视觉；OCR 引擎归入「文档解析与 OCR」
subs.def_en: Object detection, segmentation, face and pose, vision foundation models, and 3D vision; OCR engines go under Document Parsing & OCR

subs.label: 语音识别
subs.def: 语音转文字模型、推理加速与听写工具（Whisper 系、DeepSpeech 一类）
subs.def_en: Speech-to-text models, inference accelerators, and dictation tools (Whisper family, DeepSpeech)

subs.label: 语音合成、声音转换与音频处理
subs.def: 文字转语音、声音克隆与变声、音频分离，以及音频 / 音乐生成
subs.def_en: Text-to-speech, voice cloning and conversion, audio source separation, and audio and music generation

subs.label: 图像与视频生成
subs.def: 从文本、噪声或工作流生成新图像 / 视频的模型与创作界面；以修改输入图像为主要任务的工具归「图像增强与换脸」
subs.def_en: Models and creative interfaces that generate new images or video from prompts, noise, or workflows; tools primarily transforming input images belong in Image Enhancement & Face Swapping

subs.label: 图像转换、增强与换脸
subs.def: 以已有图像 / 视频为输入进行图像转换、超分、修复、去背景、局部编辑、换脸或插帧；从零生成新作品的工具归「图像与视频生成」
subs.def_en: Transform existing images or video through image-to-image translation, upscaling, restoration, background removal, local edits, face swapping, or frame interpolation; generation from scratch belongs in Image & Video Generation

subs.label: 强化学习与具身智能
subs.def: 强化学习环境与算法，以及机器人定位、建图、路径规划、运动控制和具身智能仿真；通用算法教材归全栈「算法与数据结构」
subs.def_en: Reinforcement-learning environments and algorithms, plus robot localization, mapping, path planning, motion control, and embodied-AI simulation; general algorithm textbooks belong in Full-stack Algorithms & Data Structures

subs.label: 推荐系统
subs.def: 推荐与排序系统的模型和线上服务代码，包括社交平台开源的信息流推荐算法
subs.def_en: Models and serving code for recommendation and ranking systems, including feed-recommendation algorithms open-sourced by social platforms

def_en: Models and algorithms organized by modality and task, with their open-source implementations: language and multimodal models, structured decision models, vision, speech, image and video generation, classic NLP, reinforcement learning, and recommender systems

label: 训练、推理与工具链
def: 模型开发与运行所需的框架、训练、部署、接入、评测和配套工具；按仓库的核心交付物归类，不以是否支持本机运行或提供 API 为唯一依据

subs.label: 框架与数值基础库
subs.def: 通用的深度学习 / 机器学习与模型定义框架、自动微分、分布式计算及端侧推理框架，以及 NumPy、pandas 这类基础库（PyTorch、Transformers、TensorFlow、JAX、scikit-learn、XGBoost 一类）
subs.def_en: General deep learning, machine learning, and model-definition frameworks, autodiff, distributed computing, on-device inference frameworks, and base libraries such as NumPy and pandas (PyTorch, Transformers, TensorFlow, JAX, scikit-learn, XGBoost)

subs.label: 训练与微调
subs.def: 以训练、微调、强化学习后训练或修改模型权重为核心交付物的工具与流程；附带推理功能仍按模型改造归类
subs.def_en: Tools and workflows primarily for training, fine-tuning, RL post-training, or modifying model weights; incidental inference support does not change their primary category

subs.label: 推理服务与加速
subs.def: 以多请求 / 多用户推理 API、调度和吞吐优化为核心交付物的服务引擎，以及训练与推理共用的底层加速库；可部署在本机
subs.def_en: Engines centered on multi-request or multi-user inference APIs, scheduling, and throughput, plus low-level acceleration libraries shared by training and inference; they may also run locally

subs.label: 本地推理
subs.def: 以个人电脑、手机或端侧设备上直接运行模型、或挑选适配模型为主要体验的引擎与工具；带本机 API 不自动归入推理服务类
subs.def_en: Engines and tools centered on running or selecting suitable models on personal computers, phones, and edge devices; a local API alone does not make them serving platforms

subs.label: API 网关与中转
subs.def: 统一多家模型 API、路由转发、订阅中转
subs.def_en: Unify multiple model APIs, route requests, and relay subscriptions

subs.label: 观测、评测与 Prompt 管理
subs.def: LLM 应用的链路追踪、评测、红队与 Prompt 优化
subs.def_en: Tracing, evaluation, red-teaming, and prompt optimization for LLM apps

subs.label: 标注、可视化与 Demo 工具
subs.def: 数据标注、模型可视化与可解释性、机器学习 Demo 界面等围绕模型开发的工具
subs.def_en: Tools around model development: data labeling, model visualization and interpretability, and machine-learning demo UIs

def_en: Frameworks, training, deployment, access, evaluation, and related tooling for building and running models; classify each repository by its core deliverable, not solely by local support or an API

label: 数据与检索
def: 把外部数据变成 AI 可用的输入：抓取、解析、检索

subs.label: RAG 与知识库
subs.def: 把外部文档与知识库索引、检索并提供给问答 / 生成流程；持久保存 Agent 自身执行经验和跨会话记忆归「记忆与上下文」
subs.def_en: Index and retrieve external documents or knowledge for question answering and generation; persistent agent experience and cross-session memory belong in Memory & Context

subs.label: 向量数据库
subs.def: 向量存储与相似度检索
subs.def_en: Vector storage and similarity search

subs.label: 网页抓取
subs.def: 以 LLM / Agent 使用为目标抓取网页或社交内容，输出可供模型处理的 Markdown、结构化数据或工具接口；通用爬虫归全栈的「网页抓取与数据采集」
subs.def_en: Crawl web or social content for LLMs and agents, producing model-ready Markdown, structured data, or tool interfaces; general-purpose scrapers belong in Full-stack Web Scraping & Data Collection

subs.label: 文档解析与 OCR
subs.def: PDF / Office 等文件转 Markdown、结构化信息抽取；含 OCR 引擎
subs.def_en: PDF and Office files to Markdown, plus structured information extraction; includes OCR engines

subs.label: 数据分析 / Text-to-SQL
subs.def: 用自然语言查询数据库与表格
subs.def_en: Query databases and tables in natural language

def_en: Turning external data into model-ready input: crawling, parsing, retrieval

label: Agent 基础组件
def: 给 Agent 补上记忆、手脚和运行环境的组件

subs.label: 记忆与上下文
subs.def: 持久保存并检索 Agent 的对话、执行经验和长期上下文；面向外部资料问答的文档索引归「RAG 与知识库」
subs.def_en: Persist and retrieve agent conversations, execution experience, and long-term context; document indexes for external-knowledge Q&A belong in RAG & Knowledge Bases

subs.label: Token 压缩
subs.def: 在内容进入上下文前做压缩 / 过滤，降低 token 消耗
subs.def_en: Compress or filter content before it enters the context window to cut token cost

subs.label: 浏览器自动化
subs.def: 给 Agent 用的浏览器、无头浏览器与浏览器操控 SDK
subs.def_en: Browsers, headless browsers, and browser-control SDKs built for agents

subs.label: MCP 与工具接入
subs.def: 供 Agent 调用外部软件、网站与数据的 MCP 服务器、工具接入平台、Agent CLI 和 MCP 应用框架；协议规范及官方协议 SDK 归「协议与格式规范」
subs.def_en: MCP servers, tool integration platforms, agent-facing CLIs, and MCP application frameworks that connect agents to software, websites, and data; specifications and official protocol SDKs belong in Protocols & Formats

subs.label: 沙箱与运行时
subs.def: 隔离执行 AI 生成代码 / Agent 的安全环境
subs.def_en: Isolated environments for running AI-generated code and agents safely

def_en: Components that give agents memory, hands, and a runtime

label: Agent 开发框架与平台
def: 自己动手搭 Agent / LLM 应用用的框架、平台和协议

subs.label: 代码框架 / SDK
subs.def: 用代码构建 Agent / LLM 应用的框架、SDK 与模型 API 客户端；现成的终端编码 Agent、聊天产品和可视化编排平台分别归对应应用类
subs.def_en: Code frameworks, SDKs, and model API clients for building agents and LLM applications; ready-to-use coding agents, chat products, and visual workflow platforms belong in their respective application categories

subs.label: 低代码 / 工作流平台
subs.def: 可视化编排 Agent、RAG 与自动化流程的平台
subs.def_en: Visual platforms for orchestrating agents, RAG, and automation

subs.label: 协议与格式规范
subs.def: Agent 与工具互通的开放协议、指令文件格式及官方参考 SDK；第三方 MCP 服务器和应用框架归「MCP 与工具接入」
subs.def_en: Open interoperability protocols, instruction-file formats, and official reference SDKs for agents and tools; third-party MCP servers and application frameworks belong in MCP & Tool Integration

subs.label: 多智能体仿真
subs.def: 通过多个 Agent 互动来模拟社会、群体行为或趋势的研究与仿真环境；多个模型对同一问题投票的聊天工具不属于仿真
subs.def_en: Research and simulation environments where agents interact to model societies, collective behavior, or trends; chat tools that compare model answers are not simulations

def_en: Frameworks, platforms, and protocols for building agents and LLM apps yourself

label: Agent 应用
def: 开箱即用、直接拿来用的 Agent / 聊天产品

subs.label: 个人 AI 助理
subs.def: 常驻运行在自己机器上、通过 IM 等多渠道触达的个人 Agent
subs.def_en: Always-on personal agents running on your own machine, reachable through IM and other channels

subs.label: 通用 / 研究型 Agent
subs.def: 给一个目标即可自主规划执行的通用 Agent（Manus 类、深度研究类）
subs.def_en: Agents that plan and execute autonomously from a single goal (Manus-style, deep research)

subs.label: GUI 操控 Agent
subs.def: 看屏幕、点界面，操作电脑 / 手机 / 网页的 Agent
subs.def_en: Agents that see the screen and operate computers, phones, or web pages

subs.label: 聊天客户端
subs.def: 对接云端或本地模型的现成聊天界面、桌面客户端与多模型对照问答工具；以构建 Agent 为目的的 SDK 归「代码框架 / SDK」
subs.def_en: Ready-to-use chat interfaces, desktop clients, and multi-model answer-comparison tools for cloud or local models; SDKs for building agents belong in Code Frameworks & SDKs

label: 编码 Agent 生态
def: 编码 Agent 本体，以及围绕 Claude Code / Codex 等的周边工具

subs.label: 编码 Agent
subs.def: 终端 / IDE 里读代码、改代码、跑命令的 Agent 本体
subs.def_en: Agents in the terminal or IDE that read code, edit code, and run commands

subs.label: 多 Agent 工作台
subs.def: 同时调度多个编码 Agent，按任务 / 看板 / 工作流协作
subs.def_en: Orchestrate several coding agents by task, kanban, or workflow

subs.label: 客户端与配置增强
subs.def: 给现有编码 Agent 加 GUI、终端、HUD、移动端、配置模板、供应商切换
subs.def_en: GUIs, terminals, HUDs, mobile clients, config templates, and provider switching for existing coding agents

subs.label: 代码理解与评审
subs.def: 代码知识图谱、代码库打包、最新文档注入、自动代码评审
subs.def_en: Code knowledge graphs, repo packing, up-to-date docs injection, and automated code review

def_en: Coding agents themselves, plus tooling built around Claude Code, Codex, and similar

label: Agent 技能与方法论
def: 装进现有 Agent 的 Skills / 插件 / 工作流规范

subs.label: 开发方法论
subs.def: 覆盖需求、规划、实现和复核等多个阶段的成体系 Agent 开发方法；单一任务的可安装技能归对应技能类
subs.def_en: End-to-end agent development methods spanning requirements, planning, implementation, and review; installable skills for a single task belong in the relevant skill category

subs.label: 工程实践技能
subs.def: 可安装到 Agent 的工程实践技能，聚焦编码、规划、测试、安全审计等具体任务；完整开发流程方法论归「开发方法论」
subs.def_en: Installable engineering skills for specific coding, planning, testing, or security-audit tasks; complete development processes belong in Development Methodologies

subs.label: 设计与内容技能
subs.def: 可安装到 Agent 的 UI、图表、PPT、视频、配图与文案等设计和内容制作技能；独立运行的创作应用归「内容与设计创作」
subs.def_en: Installable agent skills for UI, diagrams, slides, video, images, and writing; standalone creative applications belong in Content & Design Creation

subs.label: 行业与知识工作技能
subs.def: 科研、营销、产品、安全、人物蒸馏等领域技能包
subs.def_en: Skill packs for research, marketing, product, security, persona distillation, and more

subs.label: 技能库、管理与审计
subs.def: 官方技能库、插件目录、技能合集清单，以及技能安装、管理与安全扫描工具
subs.def_en: Official skill libraries, plugin directories, skill collections, and tools for installing, managing, and scanning skills for security

def_en: Skills, plugins, and workflow conventions that plug into existing agents

label: AI 垂类应用
def: 面向具体行业 / 场景的 AI 应用

subs.label: 金融与交易
subs.def: 选股、投研、量化交易
subs.def_en: Stock picking, investment research, quantitative trading

subs.label: 内容与设计创作
subs.def: 以 AI 生成为核心的独立内容创作应用与平台，覆盖视频、演示文稿、设计稿和社媒内容；通用发布工具归全栈业务应用，Agent 技能归「设计与内容技能」
subs.def_en: Standalone applications and platforms centered on AI-generated video, slides, designs, or social content; general publishing tools belong in Full-stack Business Apps and agent skills in Design & Content Skills

subs.label: 安全与渗透测试
subs.def: 自主渗透测试与漏洞验证
subs.def_en: Autonomous penetration testing and vulnerability validation

subs.label: 搜索、情报与舆情
subs.def: AI 搜索引擎、新闻热点与舆情监控
subs.def_en: AI search engines, news trends, and public-opinion monitoring

subs.label: 知识管理与学习
subs.def: 笔记、NotebookLM 类工具、AI 辅导、论文翻译、会议纪要
subs.def_en: Notes, NotebookLM-style tools, AI tutoring, paper translation, meeting minutes

subs.label: 求职
subs.def: 职位筛选、简历优化、自动投递与投递追踪
subs.def_en: Job screening, resume optimization, automated applications, and application tracking

def_en: AI applications for specific industries and scenarios

label: 学习资源
def: LLM、Agent、机器学习与深度学习的教程、图书、Prompt 与 Awesome 合集

subs.label: LLM 原理与训练教程
subs.def: 从零实现 / 训练大模型的课程、图书与路线图
subs.def_en: Courses, books, and roadmaps for building and training LLMs from scratch

subs.label: Agent 与应用开发教程
subs.def: Agent、RAG、Prompt 工程、Claude Code 的教程与官方 Cookbook
subs.def_en: Tutorials and official cookbooks for agents, RAG, prompt engineering, and Claude Code

subs.label: 深度学习教程与论文精读
subs.def: 深度学习的课程、图书、代码教程、论文复现与精读
subs.def_en: Courses, books, code tutorials, paper reimplementations, and paper walkthroughs for deep learning

subs.label: 机器学习与数据科学教程
subs.def: 传统机器学习、数据科学与 AI 通识的课程、图书、笔记和学习路线
subs.def_en: Courses, books, notes, and learning roadmaps for classical machine learning, data science, and general AI

subs.label: Prompt 与系统提示词
subs.def: Prompt 库与各家 AI 产品的系统提示词合集
subs.def_en: Prompt libraries and collections of AI products' system prompts

subs.label: Awesome 合集
subs.def: LLM、Agent、ML / DL / CV / NLP 方向的项目与资源精选清单（技能类清单归入「技能库、管理与审计」）
subs.def_en: Curated lists of projects and resources on LLMs, agents, ML, DL, CV, and NLP (skill-related lists go under Skill Hubs, Management & Auditing)

def_en: Tutorials, books, prompts, and awesome lists for LLMs, agents, machine learning, and deep learning
